set.body:
Objective

Expose scientifically honest interpretations of measurement forms without treating every cross-form as covariance or connectivity.

Scope and deliverables

- Add effect_coupling for any admitted fixed experimental query.
- Add covariance_coupling only for declared repeated variation with compatible positive self-block construction.
- Add canonical_coupling with explicit regularization and coherent joint covariance requirements.
- Add geometry_alignment as the linear CKA or RV-like static geometry view.
- Add Gaussian mutual information only for a coherent joint Gaussian covariance model and report units.
- Add a validating connectivity convenience that refuses insufficient capabilities.
- Make every correlation or normalization identify its axis: neural features, experimental samples, partition edges, or form entries.
- Preserve nonlinear stage order relative to partition reduction.

Acceptance evidence

- H = c c^T remains valid effect coupling but is rejected as nondegenerate normalized connectivity.
- Invalid or indefinite self-blocks cannot become correlation denominators.
- Edge-first and aggregate-first normalization remain distinct estimands and plan identities.
- Scalar Pearson correlation is recovered from the valid rank-one measurement and repeated-sample case, including sign.
- CCA spectra, CKA, and Gaussian information agree with independent reference calculations.
- Established dynamic informational connectivity is not silently redefined.

Ownership boundary

Own pure views and validation policies over completed measurement forms. Training discriminability series, inference, calibration, and causality remain adjacent systems.

Deferred non-goals

No Granger causality, effective connectivity, dynamic state model, permutation inference, group model, or learned informational-connectivity implementation.
set.title: Epic 7: Implement capability-gated coupling and connectivity views
